tts.name: fm_l1
tts.text: Mornin', Mac! Four girders need settin' on the frame. Drop 'em in the gaps and rivet 'em tight!

tts.name: fm_l2
tts.text: Crane yard, Mac. The crew left their lunchboxes all over the site. Round up all five!

tts.name: fm_l3
tts.text: Night shift at the mill. Load four crates into the hopper, and stay clear of the hot stuff!

tts.name: fm_l4
tts.text: Topping out! Forty floors up. Set the last beams and raise the flag. Hold onto that hat!

tts.name: fm_hurry
tts.text: Clock's runnin' out, Mac! Move it!

tts.name: fm_gameover
tts.text: That's a wrap, Mac. Go home and get some rest.

tts.name: fm_round
tts.text: New round, Mac. They're gettin' faster!

tts.name: fm_topped
tts.text: We topped out! Drinks are on me tonight!

tts.name: vd_taunt
tts.text: Catch me if you can, hard hat!

music.name: mus_title
music.prompt: Upbeat retro funk-rock title theme for an arcade video game about a construction worker. Punchy slap bass, driving drums, bright brass stabs, crunchy guitar riff and a playful 1980s synth lead. Confident blue-collar swagger. Instrumental, no vocals.

music.name: mus_l1
music.prompt: Bright, bouncy morning video game platformer music. Funky clean electric guitar, upbeat drums, warm bass, catchy whistle-like synth melody. Optimistic, energetic, steady groove. Instrumental, no vocals.

music.name: mus_l2
music.prompt: Dusk construction yard groove for a video game. Mid-tempo funk with clavinet, muted wah guitar, tight drums and a cheeky saxophone hook. Playful and slightly sneaky. Instrumental, no vocals.

music.name: mus_l3
music.prompt: Night shift in a steel mill, video game level music. Driving industrial electro-funk, metallic anvil percussion, pulsing synth bass, tense but fun arcade energy. Instrumental, no vocals.

music.name: mus_l4
music.prompt: Heroic sunset finale at the top of a skyscraper, video game music. Soaring synth-rock anthem with big drums, power guitar chords and a triumphant brass melody. Instrumental, no vocals.

music.name: mus_clear
music.prompt: Short triumphant arcade video game level complete fanfare with brass, funky drums and synth, ends with a big final chord. Instrumental.

music.name: mus_gameover
music.prompt: Short comedic game over jingle, sad trombone style melody over funky bass, ends on a final low note. Instrumental.
